att_reassurance_seeking.definition: Asking a partner repeatedly to confirm that the relationship is still there.
att_reassurance_seeking.example: Reassurance-seeking is asking the same question until the answer changes.

replacement_passport.definition: A new full passport issued after the old one is reported lost. It takes longer than an emergency document but works normally.
replacement_passport.example: The replacement passport will be ready in five working days.

situationship.definition: A relationship that has no agreed label. Nobody has said what it is, and nobody has asked.
situationship.example: We have been seeing each other for months and calling it a situationship.
